CHARACTER — Are you trustworthy? - CRB credit history (Metropol, CRB Africa, Creditinfo) - Bank account conduct (bounced cheques = negative) - Length of banking relationship 2. CAPACITY — Can you repay? - Monthly business revenue vs loan repayment - Debt service coverage ratio (minimum 1.25x) - Existing loan obligations 3.
